answer: The lantern test I would run is Endowed boxing referee commission with boxing board attestation: a commission the board renews after bout audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a commission the board renews after bout audits stays private; the cipher is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the timber of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
